rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable. The workflow already caches SBT dependencies via actions/setup-java@v4 with cache: sbt, so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is satisfied and its contraindication (an equivalent cache already exists) applies. The matrix explicitly sets fail-fast: false to run every Scala/project combination; switching to fail-fast: true under P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is contraindicated because each matrix outcome is a required cross-build check and full failure diagnostics are intended, and required_checks are not verified. No representative successful-duration history exists (ci_history is not_a_measured_baseline), so a custom or history-derived timeout under P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT / P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT cannot be set safely without risking false timeouts on valid slow sbt runs. Remaining patterns (cancel-stale, skip, selection, prioritization) would alter required-check semantics or require separately approved policies. Existing build and test coverage is preserved; no change is made.
